title: Stack Health across every node
blurb: Keep Stack Health on This node by default, or switch to All nodes for a progressive multi-node inventory with State, Networks, coverage, and editor jumps that land on the owning node.

title: SSO-only authentication mode
blurb: Require every sign-in on this node to go through your SSO provider instead of a local password. Turn it on once your provider is configured and tested.

title: Itemized fleet prune plans
blurb: See exactly what a fleet-wide prune will remove, broken down node by node, before you run it. The destructive action stays locked until every reachable node has returned its dry run.

title: Audit Log
blurb: Every instance ships with an audit log of who did what, and when. Find it under Security & review → Audit.

title: Fleet Secrets
blurb: Share encrypted, fleet-wide environment bundles across your nodes without copying env files by hand.

title: ntfy notification channel
blurb: Send Sencho alerts straight to ntfy, alongside the channels already supported. Configure it per node under Settings · Notifications · Channels.

title: Resizable file explorer
blurb: Drag the divider in the Files tab to give the tree pane more room, or shrink it out of the way. Your preferred width is remembered.

title: Role-based access control
blurb: Every instance ships with five built-in roles, Admin, Viewer, Deployer, Node Admin, and Auditor, plus scoped permissions to grant access to one stack or node without elevating anywhere else.

title: Git-managed Blueprint content
blurb: Move a live Git source onto a Blueprint so that Blueprint's compose comes from Git instead of the editor. Git-managed Blueprints bind and show a blocked rollout state; they do not deploy from the stored snapshot. Detach restores Inline editing.

title: HTTPS on the Sencho instance
blurb: Terminate TLS on Sencho itself when you are not using a reverse proxy. Mount a certificate and key, set SENCHO_PUBLIC_URL to https, and Pilot agents enroll over a confidential tunnel so private-registry credentials can travel.

title: Sealed private-registry credentials
blurb: Hub credentials for private images travel sealed to remote nodes, including over plain HTTP. Each node pins a sealing key on first use; reset the pin under Settings → Nodes after a rebuild.

title: Decomposed approval actions
blurb: Accept source, approve placement, and authorize rollout as separate actions on a Git-managed Blueprint, so each authority step is reviewed and recorded on its own.

title: Rollout lifecycle controls
blurb: Pause, resume, replan, supersede, or roll back a Blueprint rollout from the GitOps application view, with an explicit recovery scope and per-target results.
